contributions.detail: Five inked rows on p2 sum to 500.00 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 = 1300.00, exactly the cover's line-1 CUMULATIVE cell (and its LAST cell, since the THIS cell is a slashed-zero glyph = 0: nothing new came in this period, so the schedule restates the cycle). Rows are dated 4-1-08 through 10-10-08, i.e. the whole cycle - cumulative scope. The Carr form prints NO schedule total and no page subtotal (addendum A.1), so the cover line is the only anchor. RECONCILED AGAINST LINE 1 ONLY: the module's published stated_total_contributions is line1+line2 = 1360.37, and scoring against that would manufacture a false mismatch - the 60.37 is the <=$50 aggregate, which this form never itemizes.

expenditures.detail: Ten inked rows on p3 sum to exactly 1564.32, the cover's line-3 CUMULATIVE cell, and the filer's own pencil scratch in the bottom-right margin of p3 reads a struck '950.6-' over '1564 32' - the same figure. Rows run 3-17-08 to 10-30-08, the whole cycle, so scope is cumulative; the THIS cell (613.70) is a per-period subset the schedule does not separately mark. Cover arithmetic 950.62 + 613.70 = 1564.32 closes exactly. No schedule total is printed on the Carr form.

gates.balance_chain: Does NOT close on the form's own face, and the residual is the FILER's basis choice, not a transcription defect: cumulative contributions 1300.00 (line 1) + 60.37 (line 2) = 1360.37, minus cumulative expenses 1564.32 = -203.95. The filer instead wrote '(264.32)' beneath the cumulative balance rule (with a slashed-zero glyph ON the rule itself), which is exactly 1300.00 - 1564.32 - i.e. he computed the balance from the over-$50 line ALONE and dropped his own 60.37 small-donor aggregate. Both figures retained verbatim; nothing recomputed. The accounting parentheses make it negative 264.32. The LAST column's balance 409.75 is a prior-report figure that this document does not derive; no earlier Bigelow filing is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain was run.
